name: China National Film Museum
scope: Standing 2007 China National Film Museum in Beijing, including the notched glass northwest entry, folded charcoal cladding and the adjacent clapperboard forecourt walls.
era: Current standing museum, with principal entrance as photographed in 2025

originalReview.notes: Shows the asymmetrical cut through the charcoal plates, deep black folds, rose-tinted recessed panes, public doors and seven-character sign.

review.method: Exact Qualla façade and the Wikimedia uploader’s original CC0 grant.
review.notes: The original Qualla exterior photograph byte-matches Wikimedia’s exact photo. The first revision is own work and CC0. Wikimedia’s user redirect links the original credited handle to the current uploader. The seven other CC0 candidates depict interiors and displays.
